identity.name: Nikki Glaspie
identity.summary: Raleigh church drummer who spent five years in Beyoncé's all-female band, then Dumpstaphunk and her own New Orleans band, The Nth Power.

contribution.description: Drummer of the all-female band Beyoncé put together, for five years, then a bandleader of New Orleans funk with The Nth Power (2012).
